name: Spell Absorption (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Target one protective object/level
Duration until expended or 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create arcane objects that float about you and protect you from magic. These objects are a reflection of your personality or your connection to magic. For a lich they may be floating translucent skulls or spirits, for others they may be arcane sigils, or silvery orbs. Regardless, these protective objects circle your head or body. These objects have no effect on the world besides negating spells or spell-like effects that would affect you or would have an effect that extends into your space.

One of these objects is expended per spell level negated. For example, the lich could expend 3 of its floating skulls to negate a fireball cast at it. In the case of area-of-effect spells, it negates the entire spell, not just the part affecting you. If not enough of your protective objects remain to negate an incoming spell, the objects remain and the spell operates normally. You are not required to expend your objects on any spell and activating the objects to negate a spell is an immediate action.

The objects do not have any physical substance and do not provide cover or concealment. The objects cannot be harmed or targeted by physical or magical effects with the exception of a dispel or antimagic effect.
